t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. M'Guergo Nuba yam, kade oubum, m'Gueri o, m'ndoï o. M'Guer rokum, ngolan'to Togum goto, yi Tog yaï, Rondo yam ke yân kinga yaï. Nuba ke rang ke toï goto, ngue kordje kem yam ke madjalgue te, ngue tog. Sérère (Serer) (The Gambia; Senegal) Seede a mi e, wo Roog, wo bindaxam ndax um andon soo bugon. Mixe seede a ndik, o ňak o waages, fo waag'of, o ňakes fo jeg'of. Roog fa len jeegee faa refeerna wo, wo nufiga we ndefna na sabab, oxaa na ňoowaa o ňoon xooxum.
